clues.text: This city in Albania sits on the bank of a river on a wide plain. Low hills rise to the southeast, with one river to the north and one to the south.
clues.narrowing: rules out everything outside Albania and its southern river plains

source.quote: It is situated on the bank of Gjanica River in the Myzeqe Plain between the Seman in the north, the Vjosë in the south and the foothills of the Mallakastra Mountains in the southeast.

clues.text: The near sea to the west shapes each season. This gives it a Mediterranean climate all year long.
clues.narrowing: rules out inland and non-Mediterranean parts of the region; sea-shaped seasonal band only

source.quote: Fier experiences a seasonal Mediterranean climate affected by its proximity to the Adriatic Sea in the west.

clues.text: A rich clan built this town in past times. In 1864 a man named Omer made it a real town.
clues.narrowing: rules out older Albanian towns; shortlist of places founded in 1864

source.quote: Fier was founded in the 19th century by the Vrioni family and officially in 1864 by Omer Pasha Vrioni II, the father of Kahreman Pasha Vrioni (1889-1955).

clues.text: Close by lie the stone ruins of the old town of Apollonia. Greek settlers built it long ago in 588 BCE.
clues.narrowing: near-decisive; only one modern city sits this close to those Greek ruins

source.quote: It is 7 km (4 mi) from the ruins of the ancient settlement of Apollonia which was founded in 588 BCE by Ancient Greek colonists from Corfu and Corinth, on a site occupied by Illyrian tribes.

clues.text: This is the seventh largest city in the whole country. It is also the seat of its county and its town hall.

source.quote: is the seventh most populous city of the Republic of Albania and seat of Fier County and Fier Municipality
